reserves.name: Digital-asset cash-and-carry strategy
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Spiko Cash and Carry Fund; Marex structured-note counterparty

sources.label: Spiko Digital Assets Cash and Carry Fund prospectus, 1 February 2026, redemption gates and cash payment pages 13–14

reserveReview.rationale: The eurSPKCC API publishes aggregate share-class assets and NAV, not a constituent allocation. Marex is the structured-note counterparty and CACEIS Bank the custodian/depositary. The February 2026 prospectus permits gates above 10% net redemptions for up to twenty NAVs within one month, with carried-over orders receiving no priority; in liquidation, prior asset realization can extend payment to thirty days. The conservative whole strategy liquidity horizon is over-seven-days, not ordinary T+2 settlement or an unconditional liquidity guarantee. The aggregate strategy envelope and unknown constituent weights are preserved.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Spiko eurSPKCC share-class API snapshot and product documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Marex is the disclosed structured-note counterparty and CACEIS Bank the disclosed custodian and depositary. Current constituent positions, look-through digital-asset weights, and any internal cash or Treasury allocation remain undisclosed.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Spiko exposes the live strategy category but does not publish the current constituent positions or weights needed for tracked dependency mapping.

sources.label: Spiko Cash and Carry fund prospectus, February 1 2026

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The prospectus names CACEIS Bank as custodian and depositary, CACEIS Fund Administration as NAV accountant, and Twenty First Capital as manager. Issuer stakeholder documentation names Marex as structured-note counterparty. No current constituent allocation or provider shares were obtained; legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, and rehypothecation remain unclassified.
